Chapter 816: Chapter 20 Child Of The Void (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 816: Chapter 20 Child of the Void (Please Subscribe)

Space and time were twisting, with the Tianzhi True Lord ignoring the backlash endured.

Madly fleeing in the direction away from Tianqing World.

As a master of ‘wisdom’, the Perfect Demon True Lord is not particularly outstanding in frontal combat,

but in the art of escaping, much effort has been put in.

At this moment, disregarding everything to invoke the Power of Space-Time,

crossing ‘billions upon billions of light-years’ in an instant.

...

“Too terrifying.”

“Is that the Martial Ancestor?”

“Martial Ancestor is that strong?”

Tianzhi True Lord was profoundly shaken in his heart.

Originally.

The Taiyin Sovereign being so strong was already inconceivable.

In the vast Boundless Void, there are only so few Perfect Demon True Lords.

Suddenly, a Taiyin Sovereign stronger than the average Perfect Demon True Lord appears?

But now.

Tianzhi True Lord realizes—

The powerful Taiyin Sovereign, who left many Perfect Demon True Lords helpless,

was merely a pawn pushed to the forefront.

Behind the scenes, the Prime God manipulates everything, pushing everything forward.

The one shaking the foundations of all Evil Gods in the Boundless Void…

It’s the Martial Ancestor!

Just a distant glance a moment ago caused Tianzhi True Lord to suffer no light backlash.

Tianzhi True Lord had no doubt that if his real body ventured in, it was very likely to be completely trapped.

And to achieve this, a Perfect Demon True Lord of the Ninth Stage would not be nearly possible.

“Is that the Tenth Stage Evil God of legends? No, if it were the Tenth Stage, why hide behind the scenes, should it be an existence that is infinitely close to the Tenth Stage?

Tianzhi True Lord’s thoughts rapidly spun, and he breathed a slight sigh of relief.

As long as it’s not an entity of the Tenth Stage, then there is still room for redemption.

Up to this point.

In the vast Boundless Void.

The only known existence of the Tenth Stage is the founder of the Void Secret Realm.

Single-handedly, from gaps between dimensions outside of the void, he confined countless Void Creatures, turning them into nourishment for many Evil Gods.

It’s a pity.

Ever since the founder opened the Boundless Void, he disappeared completely.

Countless Demonic Divine Masters of later generations are essentially chasing the footsteps of the founder.

“To strangle Martial Tao, Taiyin Sovereign is secondary, the main target is Martial Ancestor.”

Tianzhi True Lord held a heavy heart, “I must join forces with all the Perfect Demon True Lords, and even need to awaken ‘that one’.”

Against the Taiyin Sovereign, Tianzhi True Lord believed that ten or twenty Perfect Demon True Lords would be enough.

But Martial Ancestor?

Tianzhi True Lord felt that summoning all the Perfect Demon True Lords would still leave him uncertain.

At the critical moment.

He could only awaken ‘that one’.

And ‘that one’…

Is the most powerful True Lord who inherited the Void Secret Realm in the vast Boundless Void after the founder disappeared.

Controlling the entire Void Secret Realm, this most powerful True Lord can exert almost the strength of the Tenth Stage.

At least in the Boundless Void, unless the founder returns, he is invincible.

…

“Hm?”

Dozens of breaths later, Tianzhi True Lord’s expression slightly changed.

Fleeing for so long, one would think he would have reached another familiar Void Domain.

However, at this moment, the void environment where Tianzhi True Lord was seemed unchanged.

The vast void, as if he had never moved.

“What’s this?”

Tianzhi True Lord’s face looked ugly.

The next moment.

Changes in space-time.

Tianzhi True Lord returned to that ‘azure’ world once more.

Re-emerging before the dreadful and trembling figure deep within the Martial Hall.

Only this time, it wasn’t an avatar, but Tianzhi True Lord’s real body in person.

“No…”

Before Tianzhi True Lord could react, consciousness rapidly plunged into darkness.

Deep in the Martial Hall.

Lin Yuan was sitting cross-legged.

Watching the Tianzhi True Lord who had completely lost consciousness not far away.

In fact.

When Tianzhi True Lord sent out an avatar to sneak into Tianqing World.

Lin Yuan had detected the other party, and the reason for not stopping and taking action at the time.

Was to lock onto the real body of Tianzhi True Lord.

Until the avatar of Tianzhi True Lord came before the Martial Hall, continuously probing.

Lin Yuan finally confirmed Tianzhi True Lord’s real body, using Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule mastery, quietly activating Divine Ability ‘World’, and stealthily transferring him into his own inner world.

Tianzhi True Lord frantically fled, and dozens of breaths believed he escaped billions of light-years, but in reality, all within Lin Yuan’s inner world.

Lin Yuan’s inner world is only over two hundred million miles in diameter.

But cascading Spatial Layers spread out, forming a Spatial-Temporal Maze, let alone Tianzhi True Lord escaping in dozens of breaths.

Even tens of years, hundreds of years, thousands of years would not be enough to escape.

“How did he find this place?”

Lin Yuan looked surprised; the Taiyin Primordial Spirit roamed the Boundless Void, occupying world after world, propagating Martial Tao, but he did not mention the origin of Martial Tao, nor Lin Yuan, the Martial Ancestor.

As for the flourishing Martial Tao of Tianqing World over the past hundreds of thousands of years?

Compared to the whole Boundless Void, it’s too insignificant.

Concealed and protected by the Ancestral Demon Tree, with Martial Tao merely limited within Tianqing World, it would be hard to attract the attention of those Perfect Demon True Lords.

“I still can’t leave without a trace.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself, somewhat as expected.

With the spread of Martial Tao, it was only a matter of time before those Perfect Demon True Lords found this place.

Lin Yuan had never thought to completely hide his existence, but to delay and buy more time for his cultivation.

“With my current spiritual will, coupled with illusion techniques, this Perfect Demon True Lord can be completely put to sleep.”

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Through karmic connections, Lin Yuan could sense that at a distant location, Tianzhi True Lord had left ‘avatars’ or similar life-saving measures.
